description: Additional pinned public inputs for dose_window.py. The GDSC1/GDSC2 fitted-response workbooks, DepMap sample table and the PRISM curve-parameter file are pinned in ../screen-consensus/sources.json and reused. Files are stored flat in CACHE under `local`; dose_window.py refuses a file whose md5 differs and verifies md5 and size after each download.

gdsc1_raw.what: GDSC1 public raw plate-reader intensities, release 8.5 (27Oct23); one row per well/tag

gdsc2_raw.what: GDSC2 public raw plate-reader intensities, release 8.5 (27Oct23); one row per well/tag

gdsc_raw_description.what: Sanger description of the raw-data columns and plate tags (NC-0/NC-1 negative controls, B blank, Lx-Dy-S titrations)

prism_collapsed_lfc.what: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary screen replicate-collapsed log2 fold change vs DMSO (ComBat-corrected), cells x drug-dose columns (figshare article 9393293, file 20237757)

prism_collapsed_treatments.what: PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 secondary screen replicate-collapsed treatment info: column_name <-> broad_id, dose (uM), screen_id (figshare file 20237763)
